Riven has just discovered an elderly man
trapped inside a nearby burning building.

She still holds her Broken Sword.

Farther down the main road,
the mysterious dark figure remains waiting in the smoke.

The elderly man calls for help again.

The damaged building begins to creak around him.

Riven looks from the trapped man
back toward the mysterious figure.

For a brief moment,
she remembers her father's words:

"To protect those who cannot protect themselves."

Riven makes her choice.

She lowers the Broken Sword.

She turns her back on the mysterious figure.

Instead of pursuing it,
Riven immediately runs toward the burning building
to save the elderly man.

=== SHOT 1 — THE MAN WHO CANNOT ESCAPE ===

OPEN on a close three-quarter view of Riven.

Continue naturally from the previous moment.

Riven is still holding the Broken Sword
in front of her.

Her attention is now directed
toward the nearby burning building.

Do not begin with combat.

Do not make Riven attack anything.


CUT toward the damaged opening of the building.

Use the provided TRAPPED ELDERLY MAN reference.

The elderly man remains behind
the same collapsed wooden debris.

Keep his position simple and consistent.

He is surrounded by smoke and orange firelight.

He tries to move,
but the fallen wooden structure blocks his escape.

He cannot free himself.


He looks toward Riven and calls:

"Help!"


Keep his delivery desperate but natural.

Do not make him theatrical.

Do not show graphic injuries.


A damaged wooden support somewhere above him
makes a loud CREAK.

Small pieces of dust and ash fall.

The elderly man looks upward briefly.

The building is becoming increasingly unstable.


CUT BACK TO RIVEN.

She understands that he does not have much time.


=== SHOT 2 — THE CHOICE ===

Riven looks at the trapped elderly man.

Then slowly turns her attention
back toward the main village road.


CUT to Riven's perspective.

Farther down the road,

the MYSTERIOUS DARK FIGURE
is STILL THERE.

It remains partially obscured by smoke.

It does not approach.

It does not attack.

It simply stands there.


Hold briefly.


CUT back to a close view of Riven.

She stares toward the figure.

The Broken Sword remains firmly in her hand.


For a brief moment,
the surrounding sound becomes slightly distant.

Do NOT show a long visual flashback.

Do NOT change location.


Instead,
Riven hears a brief memory of her father's voice:

"To protect those who cannot protect themselves."


The voice feels like a memory.

Calm.

Warm.

Distant.


Riven's expression changes subtly.

Not sadness.

Not anger.

Clarity.


She looks once more
toward the mysterious figure.


Then—

Riven slowly LOWERS THE BROKEN SWORD.


This is the decision.


She chooses not to pursue the figure.


=== SHOT 3 — SHE TURNS AWAY ===

Use a wider composition
that clearly establishes the spatial relationship.

Riven stands in the foreground.

The mysterious dark figure remains
farther down the main road behind her.

The burning building containing the elderly man
is nearby to one side.


Riven looks toward the mysterious figure
one final time.


Then she deliberately TURNS HER BACK ON IT.


Hold this visual moment briefly.

The figure connected to her past
is now physically behind her.


Riven immediately turns toward
the trapped elderly man's building.


She breaks into a fast run.


The Broken Sword remains in her hand,
lowered beside her body.

She does NOT raise it to attack.

She does NOT charge toward the mysterious figure.


Riven runs AWAY FROM THE FIGURE
and TOWARD THE TRAPPED ELDERLY MAN.


Keep the geography extremely clear:

MYSTERIOUS FIGURE
remains behind Riven on the main road.

RIVEN
moves away from it.

BURNING BUILDING
is Riven's destination.


As Riven reaches the building,
move with her toward the damaged entrance.

Through the opening,
the elderly man is still visible inside.


Riven reaches the entrance.

She looks immediately toward
the debris trapping him.


Do not begin the full rescue yet.

Do not show Riven lifting the beam yet.

Do not show them escaping yet.


End with Riven arriving
to help the elderly man.


CUT.


=== END STATE ===

Riven has chosen the trapped elderly man
over pursuing the mysterious figure.

She heard the memory of her father's words:

"To protect those who cannot protect themselves."

Riven lowered her Broken Sword.

She deliberately turned her back
on the mysterious figure.

She ran toward the burning building.

The elderly man remains trapped inside.

Riven has reached him.

The actual rescue begins next.

=== REFERENCES ===

Use the provided Riven reference for visual continuity.

Use the provided Riven weapon reference exactly as shown.

Use the provided Burning Settlement reference
for the current environment.

Use the provided Mysterious Dark Figure reference
only for the dark figure.

Maintain the same burning mountain settlement:
wooden buildings on fire,
heavy dark smoke,
orange firelight,
ash drifting through the air,
and narrow roads running deeper between the buildings.

Keep Riven's weapon visually consistent
with the provided reference throughout the entire video.

Do not redesign or alter the weapon.


=== TECHNICAL ===

16:9 cinematic live-action dark fantasy.

Grounded photorealistic realism.

Burning settlement at nightfall.

Strong orange firelight.

Heavy drifting smoke.

Natural ash and embers in the air.

Natural running movement with realistic speed,
body weight, and momentum.

Dynamic but controlled cinematic camera movement.

Natural footsteps, breathing, fire,
burning wood, wind, and environmental sound.

No dialogue.

No subtitles.

No background music.

No combat yet.

Keep the mysterious figure difficult to see
during the pursuit.

Use only THREE major cinematic shots.


=== VIDEO SUMMARY ===

Riven is looking deeper into the burning settlement
after the mysterious figure has disappeared.

Suddenly,
she hears the same strange sound
from somewhere far deeper inside the village.

Riven immediately recognizes it.

Through the distant smoke,
she briefly sees a dark figure move
across an opening between burning buildings.

Riven reacts instantly.

She breaks into a full-speed sprint
and pursues it deeper into the settlement.

During the chase,
Riven occasionally catches brief glimpses
of the dark figure moving farther ahead through the smoke.

It never remains visible long enough
for her to reach it.

The pursuit leads Riven deeper
into a more isolated part of the burning settlement.

Eventually,
Riven reaches a wider open area.

The dark figure is nowhere to be seen.

Riven slows and searches the smoke.

Then the mysterious figure finally emerges
and stands still ahead of her.

Riven stops.

They face each other.

CUT before combat begins.


=== SHOT 1 — SHE HEARS IT ===

OPEN on Riven looking down
the burning village road.

She is alone.

The mysterious figure is no longer visible.

Do not recreate a long static establishing shot.

Keep the opening brief.

Fire burns throughout the settlement.

Dark smoke moves between the buildings.

Ash drifts through the orange light.

Riven quietly scans the road ahead.


Then—

from somewhere FAR DEEPER inside the settlement,

a faint unnatural sound is heard.


Riven immediately reacts.

Her head turns sharply toward the sound.

She recognizes it.


Camera follows her gaze
far down the burning road.

At first there is only:

fire,

smoke,

burning structures,

and empty space.


Then—

far ahead,

through a temporary opening in the smoke,

a DARK HUMAN-LIKE FIGURE
moves quickly across the road
between two burning structures.


It is only visible for a brief moment.

Do not clearly reveal its face or body.

Do not make it stop and pose.

It crosses the distant opening
and immediately disappears behind smoke and structures.


Riven sees it.


There is almost no hesitation.


She immediately launches forward
into a FULL-SPEED SPRINT.


Her first steps are explosive and urgent.

The camera accelerates with her.

Riven races directly toward
the place where she saw the figure.


=== SHOT 2 — THE PURSUIT ===

Stay close to Riven
as she runs at full speed
deeper into the burning settlement.

Use a dynamic tracking camera.

Alternate naturally between:

close rear tracking,

three-quarter side tracking,

and brief low tracking near her running legs,

without turning the sequence
into many separate disconnected shots.


Riven runs hard.

Her body leans naturally forward.

Her arms drive with her stride.

Her hair and clothing react naturally
to the speed of her movement.

Her breathing becomes stronger.

Keep her weapon secure
and visually consistent with the provided reference.


The environment rushes past her.

Burning wooden buildings line the road.

Smoke moves across her path.

She passes scattered debris.

Firelight flickers rapidly across her
as she moves between structures.


Riven is not running randomly.

She is FOLLOWING the mysterious figure.


Far ahead—

another brief DARK MOVEMENT
appears through the smoke.


The figure crosses another opening.

Riven catches sight of it.

She immediately adjusts her direction
and continues the pursuit.


Keep the mysterious figure
ALWAYS FARTHER AHEAD OF RIVEN.

It never runs beside her.

It never runs behind her.

Riven never catches it during the chase.


Do not show the figure running like a normal human.

Its movement should feel strange and unnaturally fast.

A dark silhouette briefly glides
or rushes through the smoke,

then disappears again behind the environment.


Riven keeps chasing it.


The roads become narrower.

The crowd and civilians are completely gone.

The deeper Riven goes,
the more isolated the environment becomes.


She runs through another thick bank of smoke.

For a moment,
the smoke fills most of the frame.


Riven pushes through it.


=== SHOT 3 — IT STOPS RUNNING ===

Riven emerges from the smoke
into a wider open area
deep inside the burning settlement.

A small crossroads,
open village yard,
or wider section between damaged buildings.

There is more space here.

Burning structures surround the area.

Smoke drifts slowly across the ground
and between the buildings.


Riven continues running forward
for several steps.

But—

the mysterious figure is nowhere to be seen.


Riven quickly slows.

Her sprint becomes a controlled stop.


She looks ahead.

Nothing.


She looks toward one side.

Only smoke and fire.


Then toward the other.

Still nothing.


Keep the tension quiet.

Only Riven's breathing,
the fire,
and the sound of burning wood remain.


Riven becomes completely still.

She watches the smoke.


Then—

ahead of her,

a large section of dark smoke
slowly shifts.


The MYSTERIOUS DARK FIGURE
gradually becomes visible.


This time—

IT IS NOT RUNNING.


It stands motionless
on the opposite side of the open area.


Keep a clear distance between them.


The figure remains almost humanoid,
but subtly unnatural.

Its silhouette is dark.

Its shoulders appear slightly too high.

Its arms appear slightly too long.

Its edges blend unnaturally
into the surrounding smoke.

Orange firelight does not illuminate it normally.

Its face remains unclear.

No glowing eyes.

No clear facial details.


Riven immediately locks her attention onto it.


The figure does not disappear.

It does not move away.

It simply stands there.


Riven understands:

the chase is over.


Slowly,
Riven shifts her posture.

Her breathing begins to settle.

Her hand moves toward her weapon.


Keep the weapon exactly consistent
with the provided reference.


The mysterious figure remains still.


Hold a wider composition:

Riven on one side
of the burning open area.

The mysterious figure
on the opposite side.

Fire and smoke between them.


Neither attacks yet.


Hold the confrontation briefly.


CUT.


=== END STATE ===

Riven heard the mysterious figure
deeper inside the burning settlement.

She saw it briefly
and immediately pursued it at full speed.

The figure led her deeper
through the burning village.

Riven has now reached
a wider isolated area.

The mysterious figure has stopped fleeing.

It stands directly ahead of her.

Riven prepares herself.

No combat has begun yet.

CUT.
